# Correlations
## Import Libraries
```{r Import Libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(Hmisc)
source("Code/Functions/CorrelationFunction.R")
options(scipen = 999)
```

```{r plots}
# Correlogram
{ # open pdf graphics driver
  pdf(file = "Figures/NutrientsYSI/01_Correlations/NutrientsYSI-Correlations-Correlogram.pdf",
      width = 15, height = 10)
  # make correlation plot
  corrplot(cor_mat_stats$r, method = "number", outline = TRUE, type = "full", diag = TRUE,
           order = "original", 
           tl.col = "black", tl.srt = 45, mar = c(5, 5, 5, 5),
           title = "Biosphere 2 Ocean Nutrient and YSI Water Quality Correlations")
  # close graphics driver
  dev.off()
}

# Correlogram with Significance
cor_mat_stats$P[is.na(cor_mat_stats$P)] <- 1 #turn NAs into 1's (insignificant) -- only NA values are on the diagonal (temp_f compared to temp_f etc)
{ # open pdf graphics driver
  pdf(file = "Figures/NutrientsYSI/01_Correlations/NutrientsYSI-Correlations-Correlogram-Significant.pdf",
      width = 13, height = 10)
  corrplot(cor_mat_stats$r, method = "shade", type="full", order="original",
           diag = TRUE,
           tl.col = "black", tl.srt = 45, mar = c(0, 0, 4, 0),
           p.mat = cor_mat_stats$P, sig.level = 0.05, insig = "p-value",
           title = "Biosphere 2 Ocean Nutrient and YSI Water Quality Significant Correlations \n
           P-Values Labeled")
  # close graphics driver
  dev.off()
}

```
